title_zh: 续写中朝传统友谊崭新篇章——习近平总书记访问朝鲜纪实
title_en: Writing a New Chapter of Traditional China-DPRK Friendship: A Record of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Visit to North Korea
summary_zh: 中央广播电视总台推出时政纪录片，全景记录习近平总书记访问朝鲜的行程及中朝两国最高领导人的会晤。
summary_en: China Media Group released a political documentary providing a comprehensive record of General Secretary Xi Jinping's visit to North Korea and the meetings between the two nations' leaders.
